units.source_text: 《十六岁的日记》的后记里，有这样一句话：“日记至此结束。”

en.t: In the afterword to Sixteen-Year-Old's Diary, there is a sentence like this: "The diary ends here."

units.source_text: 发表《十六岁的日记》时，只发现写到五月十六日，

en.t: When Sixteen-Year-Old's Diary was published, it was only discovered that it had been written up to May 16,

units.source_text: 自然可以认为五月十六日这部分，同这里抄录的部分之间，还有几天的日记。

en.t: so it is natural to suppose that between the May 16 entry and the part copied here, there were still several days of diary entries.
